questions.stemHtml: A 68-year-old smoker man with a history of hypertension presents to the ER with complaints of palpitations and shortness of breath for the past 2 hours. On examination, his pulse is irregularly irregular with a rate of 140 beats per minute. An ECG of the patient is given below. He has poorly controlled COPD. Which of the following statements about his condition is incorrect?

options.label: A
options.text: Multiple ectopic foci due to structural damage to heart

options.label: B
options.text: Start beta blockers followed by warfarin

options.label: C
options.text: CHADS2VASc score is used to decide the need for anticoagulation

options.label: D
options.text: Amiodarone is used for chemical cardioversion
